query:
UPDATE asset a
        SET download_count = a.download_count + 1,
            last_downloaded_at = now()
        FROM proxy_cached_version pcv
        JOIN component c
          ON c.repository_id = pcv.repository_id
         AND c.name = pcv.name
         AND c.version = pcv.version
        WHERE pcv.id = $1
          AND a.component_id = c.id
          AND a.path LIKE '%.nupkg'
